text: 你较长的双腿轻而易举地追上了那个小个子。你伸手牢牢抓住他的手臂，把他从地上拽了起来。
那人瞬间不再惊慌，转而怒吼着向你扑来。职业道德要求你活捉他。
对手的格斗（斗殴）技能为50%（25/10），他只想把你打昏。他先行动，每次攻击造成1D3点伤害。你可以尝试闪避他的攻击。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 228
text: Your longer legs decisively outstrip the tiny man. You reach out, clench him firmly around the arm, and yank him off his feet.
The man’s distress drops in an instant. He snarls and comes at you in a rage. Professional ethics require you to take him alive.

Your opponent’s Fighting (Brawl) skill is 50% (25/10) and he simply tries to pummel you into unconsciousness. He acts first and his blows deal 1D3 damage. You may attempt to Dodge against his attacks.
